notes: Deep read-only audits. Zero write-capable MCPs — read-only servers only. M1: at spend time codex-invoke enumerates the live base once (codex mcp list --json), disables everything not in mcp_allowlist, and re-uses that single set for both --print-command and launch (spec §2e). Because skills_allowlist is non-empty AND mcp_allowlist is non-empty, a scoped run stages an ephemeral CODEX_HOME with a materialized config.toml carrying exactly the allowlisted MCP defs plus these scalars (spec §2b). captured_mcp_defs and base_snapshot_hash are populated by codex-doctor at deploy time (harvest + pin, spec §2b/§2c) — intentionally empty in the versioned source.
